title: Combined Extraction of Exocrine Secretion and RNA in Small Arthropods
author: David Fröhlich
materials: Prepare all chemicals and equipment for RNA extraction. We used Promega ReliaPrep‱ RNA Miniprep System for RNA extraction. Steps according the manunfacturers protocol are marked with.* We recommend to check the manufacturers protocol for more details before starting wth the extraction. Here you can find the manufacturers protocol: reliaprep-rna-tissue-miniprep-system-protocol.pdf

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary chemicals and hardware for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNase I by adding nuclease-free water; mix gently (do not vortex) and store at -20°C in aliquots.
Prepare LBA + TG Buffer by adding 1-Thioglycerol to LBA Buffer.
Prepare RNA Wash Solution and Column Wash Solution by adding 95% ethanol (volumes per manufacturer's protocol p. 7f).
Obtain 100% isopropanol and methylene chloride.
Set up a box of crushed ice at the fume cupboard.
Ensure a homogenizer and centrifuge are ready.
Prepare 2 x 1.5ml eppendorf-tubes, one Beadbug prefilled 2ml tube with 1mm Triple-Pure-High-Impact Zirconium Beads, and one additional eppendorf-tube per sample; label accordingly.

steps.title: Extract Exocrine Secretion
steps.instruction: Perform chemical extraction of secretions from the organism.

substeps.instruction: Label two GC-MS vials with glass inlets and cool them in crushed ice.
Pipette 30 µL of methylene chloride into one GC-MS vial.
Transfer the individual(s) into the GC-MS vial.
Extract for 15 minutes while keeping the vials on crushed ice (adjust time based on species knowledge).
Transfer the secretion-loaded solvent into a new vial and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Prepare the organism for RNA extraction through lysis and mechanical homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Allow any remaining solvent on the individuals to evaporate, then transfer the individuals into the bead-filled tubes.
Pipette 250 µL LBA + TG Buffer into the bead-filled tube (double volume to 500 µL if organism is >5mg to 20mg).
Homogenize samples at 4m/s for 20 seconds, repeated after 20 seconds (samples may be stored at -20°C to -70°C for up to 3 months after this step).

steps.title: Lysate Preparation and Purification
steps.instruction: Process the homogenate to isolate the RNA lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL RNA Dilution buffer (RDB) (double volume for larger organisms), vortex for 10 seconds, and incubate for 1 minute.
Transfer the lysate into a new eppendorf-tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g at room temperature for 3 minutes to pellet debris.
Transfer the cleared lysates to clean tubes, avoiding the pellet.
Add 170 µL 100% isopropanol (use 340 µL for large samples).

steps.title: RNA Column Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the ReliaPrep minicolumn.

substeps.instruction: Using clean gloves, set up one ReliaPrep minicolumn, two Collection Tubes, and one Elution Tube per sample.
Place the minicolumn into a Collection Tube.
Transfer up to 700 µL of lysate to the minicolumn and centrifuge at 12,000-14,000 x g at 20-25 °C for 1 minute.
If the original LBA + TG volume was 500 µL, repeat the centrifugation step for the remaining lysate.
Discard the liquid in the Collection Tube and replace the minicolumn.

steps.title: RNA Washing and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash the column and remove contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of RNA Wash Solution to the minicolumn and centrifuge at 12,000-14,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Discard the liquid in the Collection Tube and replace the minicolumn.
Prepare DNase I incubation mix in a sterile tube by combining 24 µL Yellow Core Buffer, 3 µL 0.09M MnCl2, and 3 µL DNase I enzyme (mix by gentle pipetting; do not vortex).
Apply 30 µL of the DNase I mix directly to the membrane, ensuring full coverage.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature (+20 to +25°C).
Add 200 µL of Column Wash Solution and centrifuge at 12,000-14,000 x g for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Final Column Washing
steps.instruction: Perform final washes to clean the RNA membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of RNA Wash Solution and centrifuge at 12,000-14,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Discard the Collection Tube and place the minicolumn into a new Collection Tube.
Add 300 µL of RNA Wash Solution and centrifuge at high speed for 2 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the minicolumn to a capped 1.5ml Elution Tube.
Add 15 µL Nuclease-Free Water to the membrane (double volume for large samples), ensuring the surface is completely covered.
Incubate for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 12,000-14,000 x g for 1 minute.
Remove and discard the column; cap the Elution Tube and store RNA at -70°C.
Optional: Repeat elution by adding another 15 µL Nuclease-Free Water, incubating for 1 minute, and centrifuging at 12,000-14,000 x g for 1 minute.
